objective: Write FP64 raw signed net inside the exact general and PN CUDA consumer kernels, before tanh; retain stable graph buffers and read only after an accepted 1-ms step. Admit four-arm 400-ms measurement only after an exact observer on/off control.
biology: Unchanged checkpoint, equations, signed weights, anatomy, body, onset and tolerances. Diagnostic stores only; no feedback to neuronal state.

alternatives.I: Native sideband inside both consumer kernels (this prototype)
alternatives.II: Full shadow evaluator with all temporary APL and PN buffers, only if I fails and independently budgeted
alternatives.III: Matched causal port perturbations, only after readout validation

rivals.A: Peripheral/ALLN or ORN-PN filtering loses or reverses lateral signal
rivals.B: Posterior convergence loses or reverses a preserved PN contrast
rivals.C: Basal state, DNa02 readout, effector or body masks correct signal

precommitted.smoke: One ms sham off/on from same checkpoint; exact body, CNS, pending sensor and event state comparison; selected kernel raw must reproduce actual accepted-stage target to 1e-9 absolute and rate to 1e-12. Capture only an accepted final coefficient stage. No inferred raw from clipped or saturated tanh.
precommitted.full_if_smoke_passes: Four arms sham, uniform, odor_left, odor_right to 400 ms from same preparation; evaluate absolute yaw and all contrasts at 320 and 400 ms, with the historical 150-300 ms criterion unchanged. 250-400 ms is descriptive, not PASS selected after results.
precommitted.scientific: No biological mechanism claim until numerical error to interpreted horizon is <=1e-4 and observer on/off unchanged. A single four-arm life cannot establish cross-fly generality.

stop: Stop at first failed smoke or numerical gate, or budget. Preserve every receipt.
